workflow_rationale: Greenfield static site implementation requiring multiple components (project setup, templates, CSS, content, deployment). No existing code to migrate - building from scratch following 11ty conventions.

phases.name: Core Templates
phases.description: Create Nunjucks base layout and reusable component partials

subtasks.description: Create site.json with global metadata (title, description, author, contact)
subtasks.notes: Created src/_data/site.json with global metadata including: name, title, description (German SEO text), author (Rita Tomforde), lang (de), and contact object with name, location (Reith), and region (Altes Land / Stade). Verification passed - file contains Rita Tomforde. Committed to git.

subtasks.description: Create base.njk layout with HTML structure, head, and body wrapper
subtasks.notes: Created src/_includes/base.njk with complete HTML5 structure. Includes: lang="de" attribute, meta charset and viewport, SEO meta tags (description, author), conditional title from site.json, CSS link with | url filter for GitHub Pages path handling, nav.njk and footer.njk includes, {{ content | safe }} for main content. Verification passed - file contains lang="de" and content|safe.

subtasks.description: Create nav.njk partial with site navigation and section links

verification.expected: Contains nav element and Atelier text

subtasks.notes: Created src/_includes/nav.njk with semantic navigation structure. Includes: site-header container with main-nav element, logo/title using {{ site.name }}, hamburger button with ARIA attributes for mobile menu toggle, nav-menu with anchor links to all 7 sections (willkommen, ueber-mich, inspiration, dankbarkeit, ausstellungen, aktuelles, galerie). All paths use | url filter for GitHub Pages compatibility. German aria-labels for accessibility.

subtasks.description: Create footer.njk partial with contact info and copyright
subtasks.notes: Created src/_includes/footer.njk with: semantic footer element, contact section using site.json data (contact.name, contact.location, contact.region), call-to-action text for interested visitors, copyright with dynamic year and {{ site.author }}, footer navigation with Impressum and Datenschutz anchor links using | url filter. Verification passed - footer element detected. Committed to git with hash d140a59.

phases.name: CSS Design System
phases.description: Create CSS stylesheet matching silke-siemers.de design with custom properties and responsive breakpoints

subtasks.description: Create styles.css with CSS custom properties for colors, typography, and spacing
subtasks.notes: Created src/css/styles.css with comprehensive CSS custom properties including: colors (primary, secondary, accent, text variants, background, border), typography (font-family Georgia serif, font-size scale from 13px to 42px using rem units, font-weights, line-heights), spacing (unit-based scale with xs/sm/md/lg/xl/section), layout (container max-width 1200px), transitions, shadows, border-radius, and z-index scale. Verification passed - :root with --color- and --font- properties detected. Committed with hash 68180bf.

subtasks.description: Add base reset, typography styles, and container layout
subtasks.notes: Added comprehensive CSS base styles including: CSS reset (box-sizing, margin/padding reset), smooth scroll behavior, body typography with Georgia serif font, heading styles (h1-h6 with proper size scale using CSS variables), paragraph/link/list styles with transitions, .container class with max-width: 1200px and auto centering, .container-narrow (800px) and .container-wide (1400px) variants, .section/.section-alt helper classes for consistent spacing, and .sr-only utility for accessibility. Verification passed - container class with max-width detected. Committed with hash 7a79539.

subtasks.description: Add navigation styles with mobile hamburger menu support
subtasks.notes: Added comprehensive navigation styles including: sticky header, nav container with flexbox, logo/title styling, nav menu with horizontal links, hamburger button with 3-line icon and animation states, mobile slide-in panel for screens under 768px, tablet adjustments, and desktop enhancements. All styles use CSS custom properties for consistent theming.

subtasks.description: Add section styles (hero, content sections, gallery grid)

verification.expected: Contains hero, section, and gallery styles

subtasks.notes: Added comprehensive section styles including hero section with responsive adjustments, content sections with header/title/subtitle styles, about section layout, exhibitions list, event cards, and a full responsive gallery grid (1-4 columns). All styles use CSS custom properties from the design system.

subtasks.description: Add responsive media queries for tablet and desktop breakpoints
subtasks.notes: Added comprehensive responsive media queries for tablet (768px) and desktop (1024px) breakpoints. Includes: typography scaling, container padding adjustments, section spacing, grid utilities (2-col, 3-col, 4-col), flexbox row utilities, text alignment utilities, and print styles. Verification passed - grep finds all expected media queries.

subtasks.description: Add footer styles
subtasks.notes: Added comprehensive footer styles including site-footer, footer-container, footer-content, footer-brand, footer-title, footer-tagline, footer-contact, footer-nav, footer-divider, footer-bottom, footer-copyright, and responsive adjustments for 768px and 1024px breakpoints. Also updated print styles to hide footer.
